subject: Model selection artifacts & request to freeze model updates
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marco Ruiz <marco@lendcore.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Model selection artifacts & request to freeze model updates

Hi Marco — great conversation this morning, thanks for walking us through the scoring flow and some sample edge cases. Quick recap + next steps from our side: 

1) Model recommendations (initial):
   - rdx-bert-large-qa-2026-09 (best latency/precision for short-form credit questions)
   - rdx-llama2-13B-q4f16 (better on long-form explanations, slightly higher cost)

2) Deliverables attached: benchmark CSV and the prompt set we used during the call. The CSV includes average latency, 95th pct latency, and F1 on your Golden QA set.

3) Immediate ask: given you mentioned this is a pilot touching production scoring, our applied ML lead (Priyom) recommends we place an emergency freeze on model updates for your environment while we run a focused regression check against the origin snapshot you provided. This would prevent automatic rollout of any new model binary that could introduce a regression.

4) Suggested next steps:
   - We will run the regression diffs on your 2k golden prompts (Priyom) and share an articulate diff summary.
   - Ops (Marissa): please hold any model auto-upgrades for LendCore until we confirm stability.
   - Marco: can you confirm a 30–45 min sync tomorrow for us to walk through the diff artifacts?

Attachments: [attachment: lendcore-fit-benchmarks.csv (csv, 120KB)], [attachment: lendcore-prompt-set-v1.txt (txt, 8KB)]

Thanks — looping Priyom and Marissa for details.

—Karthik

Thanks Karthik — got the files. Quick question from the DS side: for the rdx-bert-large-qa you recommended, how did it perform on our long-tail legalese examples? I saw a note in the CSV but want to confirm whether the degradation is acceptable for our compliance checks.

I can do a 30-min sync tomorrow at 10:30am PT if that works for your team.

—Marco
Marco Ruiz | Head of Integrations, LendCore
marco@lendcore.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Preliminary diff findings and freeze rationale (LendCore)

Internal — do not forward external yet.

Quick notes after a fast pass on the Golden set: 
- rdx-bert-large-qa baseline (2026-09-10 snapshot) vs current hosted binary (2026-10-01) shows a systematic drop in answer span F1 on legalese subset (~6.2 percentage points).
- The regression is concentrated on inputs that contain embedded statutes and nested bullet lists — appears to be a tokenization/context window handling change after the recent tokenizer tweak.
- I exported a short diff summary (attached) and a sample prompt/pred pairs for triage. If this reproduces on LendCore's 2k set, it could materially impact their compliance scoring.

Recommendation: place an emergency freeze for LendCore's tenant so the runtime will serve the pinned snapshot (2026-09-10) until we finish triage. This is less intrusive than a full rollback but prevents any scheduled binary updates from hitting their environment.

Attachments: [attachment: diff-summary-20261006.pdf (pdf, 85KB)]

Priyom
Priyom Das | Applied ML, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Preliminary diff findings and freeze rationale (LendCore)

Acknowledged — ops will enact a tenant-level freeze for LendCore today. Steps I'm taking: 
1) Create a temporary policy on the serving control-plane to pin tenant "lendcore-prod" to snapshot id: rdx-bert-large-qa@2026-09-10 (holding on any auto-upgrades).
2) Create a one-time audit ticket and alert to monitor any attempted deployments.
3) Share the pin evidence and ticket ID with the team + AMs so we can tell the customer it's done.

I'll post the ticket number when it's created. Priyom — please share the triage artifact pack (samples + metric deltas) as soon as available and we'll extend the freeze window if necessary.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Production Ops
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Model selection artifacts & request to freeze model updates

Marco — thanks for the quick turnaround and the sync earlier today. Two quick updates for your team: 

- We've placed a tenant-level freeze for LendCore. Ops ticket: RWF-4418. Your environment is pinned to rdx-bert-large-qa@2026-09-10 while we complete the triage.
- Priyom has uploaded the diff pack to the shared Drive (link below); it contains 150 flagged examples, metric deltas, and suggested mitigation prompts.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d_lendcore-eval-2026

Would you like us to include a short report for your legal/compliance team summarizing the change and remediation timeline?

Best —
